item.title: Ways to Protect the Environment - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Discover four meaningful, high-impact ways to protect the environment—beyond simple lifestyle tips. Learn how passion, policy, community, and ocean-focused action can create real change.

item.title: 2025 Greatest Hits of the CORAL Blog - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: This year was a big one for coral reefs and the Coral Reef Alliance! As the year comes to a close, we’re looking back at the stories that resonated most. The ones that traveled farthest, sparked curiosity, and helped connect more people to the future of coral reefs. Over 120,000(!!) of you read our stories… Continue Reading →

item.title: Biodiversity, the Secret Superpower of Coral Reefs - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Discover why coral reefs are biodiversity hotspots, how every species plays a role, and why protecting reef life matters for oceans and people alike.

item.title: Why Divers Matter More Than Ever for the Future of Coral Reefs - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Discover why divers are vital to coral reef conservation. Their firsthand observations and deep connections to local reefs help drive meaningful action, protect ecosystems, and amplify conservation efforts. Explore how underwater communities can join forces with CORAL to protect the reefs they love!

item.title: Meet Antonella, a Biologist and Diver Shaping the Future of Coral Reefs - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Meet CORAL’s Senior Manager of Conservation Science and learn how Dr. Antonella-Rivera bridges science and action to drive community-led coral reef conservation worldwide.

item.title: What Impact Really Means in Conservation and the Numbers Every Coral Reef Donor Should Watch - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Learn the value of a conservation impact report and which coral reef metrics truly matter, from water quality to protected area management and science-backed action.

item.title: From Ridge to Reef, Science to Action Across Maui Nui - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: From ridge to reef, discover how Maui Nui is turning science to action with Indigenous knowledge and community-led restoration to strengthen coral reef resilience in Hawaiʻi.

item.title: Local Leadership, Lasting Impact Across the Western Caribbean - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: See how CORAL’s 2025 work in the Western Caribbean reduced pollution, strengthened reef management, and supported coral resilience.

item.title: How Coral Reef Conservation Delivered Measurable Impact in 2025 [REPORT] - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Explore how the Coral Reef Alliance is driving real change for reefs and communities in the 2025 Impact Report. Dive into stories of resilience and learn how coral ecosystems are adapting.

item.title: Coral Bleaching Awareness Month is Moving to September - Coral Reef Alliance
item.description: Coral Bleaching Awareness Month is moving to September. Learn what CBAM is, how it started, and why September is the right time to focus global attention on coral bleaching and reef protection.
